question: To what two kinds of qualified persons is this teaching said to be given?
premises: The teaching is marked as to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: Transmission is restricted to one endowed with all states and to one of resolved mind.
uncertainties: Whether both conditions must hold together is not made explicit here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, and to one of resolved mind.
